name: Abdul Basir Khan
headline: Making complex things feel simple. And a little more human.
intro: I design intuitive digital experiences—from enterprise platforms and government services to mobile products—with a soft spot for clarity, thoughtful details, and the people using them.
about: With 7+ years across product design, UI/UX, visual identity and motion, I’ve designed government platforms, enterprise tools and mobile experiences. I enjoy shaping the big picture—how a product works for different people—as much as the small interactions that make it feel natural.
aboutLead: I’m Abdul Basir Khan, a multidisciplinary designer who likes finding clarity in complicated things.
aboutExtra: My background in industrial design at NUST taught me to approach problems as connected systems. Since then, I’ve brought that curiosity into digital products, leading design work, collaborating with teams, and making complex workflows easier to understand.
